source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Arhip»

attestations.note: The page the calendar links under this name carries the name and nothing else — no life, no troparion, no year — so nothing identifies him with the Archippus of Chonae the Russian and Serbian calendars keep on 6 September, who was a sacristan and not a martyr.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Φιλήμων, Άρχιππος και Ονήσιμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and keeps him in a line of three exactly as doxologia does. The page gives no year and no place for any of the three. The third man of the line has no folder and is drafted as `onesimus-6-july`. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
